title: Reject anonymous callers on every protected route handler
preconditions: No session cookie is sent with the requests.

steps.action: PUT /api/experiences/exp_001 with a JSON body and no session.
steps.expected: 401 with a JSON error and no change to the record.
401 and the record still resolves afterwards.

steps.action: POST /api/canonical/ingest with a draft body and no session.
GET /api/experiences/user and POST /api/extract with no session.

cleanup: Confirm the record count is unchanged after the requests.
risk: Read-only in effect. Never send a forged session.
